requirements: R1: Reconcile task status by checking GitHub PR merge status before marking task as done.

slices.title: Fix GitHub PR status synchronization bug
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub synchronization patch for this epic, I want to fetch and verify the actual GitHub PR merge state, so that the internal task status correctly reflects reality.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an associated PR closed but not merged
When the status synchronization runs
Then the task state must not be marked as done
Given the implementation is complete
When the automated tests run
Then the test suite must verify the GitHub PR merge state reconciliation logic
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive task completions from GitHub desyncs to 0
